audience: winemakers and cellar teams tracking production in InnoVint

useCases.title: Review a lot’s cellar history
useCases.text: Find a lot, inspect its current details and review the winery’s recorded work history for context on additions, transfers and other cellar activity.

useCases.title: Compare recent lab results
useCases.text: Review a lot’s recorded pH, SO2 or other analyses over a chosen date range, using analysis types to select the measurements you need.

useCases.title: Review fruit intake for a vintage
useCases.text: Inspect grower receipts for a vintage alongside growers, vineyards and fruit receiving actions to review the recorded harvest intake.

useCases.title: Record confirmed analysis results
useCases.text: Find the lot and analysis type, then record confirmed values and units at the intended effective time. The new analysis action becomes part of the winery’s records.

useCases.title: Add a winery supplier
useCases.text: Check the connected winery’s existing vendors for a duplicate, then add a supplier by name when it is missing.
